title: UPDATE: Baseten Makes Serverless AI Training Platform Loops Generally Available

tickers.name: Datadog, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The company has launched the wide release of its supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) tool, providing a serverless environment for training open-weight AI models. Baseten Loops allows developers to run training tasks from a laptop without managing GPUs, featuring pay-per-token pricing for training and sampling and a one-click deployment process from trained checkpoints to production inference.

The release is the final update in a series of infrastructure additions to Baseten's inference platform this week, which also saw the launch of its Sandboxes VM environments and Grid model router. Current users of Loops include Datadog, which employs the tool for multi-turn agentic RL, and LangChain, which uses it for post-training on agent traces.

Baseten Loops is now GA, and serverless.

Teams at @AmbienceAI, @datadoghq, and @LangChain  use the Loops SDK for SFT and RL training to build durable intelligence. 

Serverless Loops includes:
- Always-warm infra that eliminates cold starts
- Model-specific numerical validation, with a focus on reducing mismatch between training and sampling
- Pay-per-token pricing for training and sampling
- One-click deployment from your trained checkpoint to production inference

You bring the data, reward functions, and training logic.
We handle the infrastructure. 
You always own the weights.

selectedTweets.text:
We're doing 3 launches this week, expanding Baseten's inference platform:

- Grid: gateway, intelligent router, and guardrails for coding agents (launching on Wednesday)
- Sandboxes: stateful, VM-isolated, and co-located with inference (launching on Thursday)
- Loops: serverless RL and SFT on frontier open-weight models (GA on Friday)

What excites me most is bringing training, inference, routing, and execution onto the same platform and showing what becomes possible when they're built to work together.

More to come all week.

Inference, training, routing, governance, and sandboxes are the building blocks of every AI product today.

We’ve learned a lot from our customers about what it takes to build that system well: @OpenEvidence trains models that outperform the closed frontier, then serves them on Dedicated Inference. @datadoghq post-trains on Loops. @Opendoor routes every AI request across the company through Grid.

This week we have three launches expanding our inference platform:

- Grid: gateway, intelligent router, and guardrails for every model your company uses (launching tomorrow)

- Sandboxes: stateful, VM-isolated environments for agents that scale to thousands of instances in seconds (launching Thursday)

- Loops: serverless SFT and RL on open-weight models, deployable straight to Dedicated Inference (GA Friday)

@amiruci, @saimaddali, @paul_s3i, and @oneill_c break down what we're launching. You might notice the visuals have a new look as well.
